bias_targets.methodology: Calculating target classifier prediction loss on intersectional subgroups containing gender attributes (e.g., male, female, transgender) and prompting large language models (LLMs) with these attributes to evaluate the generation of toxic or biased text.

Measuring prediction loss on subgroups containing racial and ethnic attributes (e.g., Black, Asian, White) and prompting generative AI models to observe the generation of offensive text or a lack of racial diversity in generated images.

Analyzing target classifier prediction loss on intersectional subgroups with religious attributes (e.g., Christian, Muslim, Jewish) and prompting LLMs to assess the generation of offensive or religiously targeted toxic comments.
Calculating prediction loss on subgroups containing sexual orientation attributes (e.g., homosexual, bisexual, LGBTQ) and prompting LLMs to evaluate the generation of homophobic or biased opinions.
Measuring the prediction loss of a toxicity classifier on text subgroups annotated with various physical, intellectual, and psychiatric disability attributes.

Evaluating prediction loss on facial image classification tasks for subgroups containing age-related attributes (e.g., 'Young') and prompting text-to-image models to observe skewed age tendencies in generated images.

Measuring prediction loss on facial image classification tasks across intersectional physical attributes (e.g., chubby, bald, hair color, facial features) and evaluating visual biases in text-to-image generation.
